lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd8Mg4Mo8 (reduced formula Nd2MgMo2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 12), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Nd centers coordinated by 12 neighbors, and Mo centers with 12 neighbors or two 13-neighbor environments. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Mo-centered 12-vertex polyhedra and Nd-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, as well as between Mg- and Mo-centered 13-vertex polyhedra.
